title: sawers-rellan-labs/zealgt pipeline parameters
description: ZEAL genotyping: raw libraries to analysis-ready CRAMs (CRAM workflow) and CRAM store to ancestry and imputed genotypes (genotype workflow)

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Sample sheet of the entry: paired FASTQs (read_trimming / read_alignment, assets/schema_input.json) or CRAMs to import (markdup_import, assets/schema_import.json; default meta/dev_import.csv).

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

samples.description: The single sample sheet (meta/samples.csv): library, raw location, inline barcodes, read-group fields per sample.

workflow_and_entry.title: Workflow and entry
workflow_and_entry.description: Which workflow runs and from which stage (docs/PLAN_pipeline.md §3).

workflow.description: cram: raw libraries -> analysis-ready CRAMs; genotype: CRAM store -> genotypes (skeleton, not implemented).

entry.description: CRAM-workflow stage to start from; every entry ends at the CRAM stop point.

force_demux.description: Libraries to demultiplex although the registry lists them (PLAN §0 Task 2).

max_libraries.description: Libraries per read_demultiplexing run (one library in flight, PLAN §5 rule 3).

subsample.description: Read pairs per library for Gate 1 (0 = all). Store outputs go to <store>/subsample_<N>.

import_sets.description: markdup_import: restrict to these import_set values (comma-separated).

raw_r1_glob.description: R1 lane files of a plain-FASTQ library inside its raw_location.

raw_r2_glob.description: R2 lane files of a plain-FASTQ library inside its raw_location.

store_and_reference.title: Store and reference
store_and_reference.description: Permanent store (storeDir, /rsstu) and the B73 v5 reference.

store.description: Store root: demux_qc/, cram/, cram_import/, registry/ (PLAN §5 rule 2).

fasta.description: B73 v5 FASTA with .fai and the minibwa index (.l2b, .mbw) next to it.

registry_seed.description: Libraries demultiplexed before zealgt (PLAN §0), counted as registered.

read_processing_settings.title: Read-processing settings
read_processing_settings.description: Decided settings (PLAN §3, §4), recorded in every provenance record. Change only deliberately.

read_structure_symmetric.description: R1 and R2 read structure (fgbio notation) of symmetric inline-barcode libraries (BC1, BC2S3 batch 2).

read_structure_r1_only.description: R1 and R2 read structure of R1-only barcode libraries (BC2S3 batch 1).

trim_adapters.description: Adapter FASTA for Trimmomatic ILLUMINACLIP (TruSeq3-PE-2.fa as shipped with trimmomatic 0.39).

trim_illuminaclip.description: ILLUMINACLIP seed mismatches : palindrome : simple thresholds.

trim_args.description: Trimmomatic steps after ILLUMINACLIP (batch 1's parameters, PLAN §3 row 1b).

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).

zealgt_run_options.title: zealgt run options
zealgt_run_options.description: Options of a zealgt run on hazel.

run_id.description: Run name; the run's work/ and TMPDIR go to /share/maize/frodrig4/nf_work/<run_id> (profile hazel).
